mathematical_comparison.condition: SUMmin-full Σ_i min_A E_p K_i(T,A)≤W for every finite catalog, complete pure SPE σ, and mixed legal query p
mathematical_comparison.result: The finite minimax path-menu value is ≤W/m; static m-slot decomposition gives OPT_m≤2m·v_(m+1)(0)≤2m·M_path≤2W. For m=6, OPT_6≤2W.
mathematical_comparison.pure_query: For p=δ_T choose A=T in every row; forced T makes denominators positive and K_i(T,T)≤u_i(Z_i(T))≤u_i(actual), so Σ_iR_i(δ_T)≤W.
mathematical_comparison.mixed_gap: The inequality min_A E_p K_i(T,A)≥E_p min_A K_i(T,A) is generally not an equality; pure row choices A=T depend on the sampled T. No uniform mixed SUMmin proof was found.
mathematical_comparison.sharpness_boundary: The static decomposition has m comparison slots and m competitive slots, hence 2m. No 2m−1 replacement or direct SUMmin proof follows.

rejected_inferences: Pure query bounds imply the all-p mixed SUMmin budget.
Finite saved p or floating-point cone probes certify the universal SUMmin candidate.
The末位 exact discount can be recursively reused for every early position.
The static 2m chain can be sharpened to 2m−1 by deleting the forced slot without a new payment interface.
A conditional implication proves the open six-provider target or changes SUMmin truth_status.
computations: No solver, LP, SPE search, enumeration, checkpoint, commit, push, or map done. Only source reading, SHA-256 hashing, derivation, edge-bind --write and edge-check were performed.
